name: Beacon Arc
description: USDC firewall for agents on Arc. The owner sets policy and the recipient allowlist. The agent signs an EIP-712 action. The executor relays it and cannot change the fields. Swap, CCTP, privacy, post-quantum signing, x402, and ERC-8004 are not executable in this deploy.
executionScope: Beacon vault executor only. The agent never receives a private key.
